decks.notes: The main concept of the deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Faithless Looting and Entomb, and then reanimate them onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. This combo-focused strategy aims to cheat expensive creatures into play early in the game, overwhelming the opponent with powerful threats. The deck also includes disruption elements like Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect the combo. Overall, the deck focuses on quickly assembling and executing a powerful reanimation combo.

This deck focuses on quickly and efficiently bringing powerful creatures back from the graveyard using cards like Exhume, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The goal is to cheat out high-impact creatures like Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Grief as early as possible, overwhelming the opponent with their powerful abilities. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Unmask and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to assemble the combo pieces and quickly reanimate powerful creatures to outpace the opponent and secure victory.

The main concept of the deck is to aggressively control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan using a combination of disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Spell Pierce, removal spells like Unholy Heat and Snuff Out, and countermagic like Daze and Force of Will. The deck aims to apply pressure with efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, while also manipulating the top of the deck with cards like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. The mana base is focused on providing access to all three colors of mana while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with Wasteland.

The main concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to aggressively control the board with cheap spells like Lightning Bolt and Force of Will while using card selection tools like Ponder and Brainstorm to maintain consistency. Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler provide early threats, while Murktide Regent offers a powerful finisher. Mishra's Bauble provides additional card draw, and Wasteland disrupts the opponent's mana base. The deck aims to maintain pressure on the opponent while disrupting their game plan, utilizing a mix of control and aggression to secure victory.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through the use of lands and removal spells. It utilizes cards like Knight of the Reliquary, Elvish Reclaimer, and Crop Rotation to search for key lands like Thespian's Stage and Dark Depths to create a powerful Merit Lage token. The deck also includes various hate cards like Collector Ouphe to disrupt opponents' strategies. By using a combination of powerful lands, creatures, and removal spells, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue opponents in the long run.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands and disruptive spells to slow down the opponent's game plan. By employing cards like Wasteland, Sphere of Resistance, and Crop Rotation, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's mana base and strategy. It also utilizes the powerful land combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 indestructible creature. The inclusion of Life from the Loam allows for consistent land recursion, while cards like Maze of Ith and Crucible of Worlds provide additional defensive options. Overall, the strategy revolves around land manipulation and disruption to outlast and outplay the opponent.

The deck focuses on utilizing Gaea's Cradle to generate massive amounts of mana and ramp into powerful creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes control elements like Snuff Out and Endurance to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The deck also has a toolbox approach with cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Fiend Artisan to tutor for specific creatures as needed. Overall, the deck aims to control the game while ramping up to powerful threats to overwhelm the opponent.

The key concept of this Grixis Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and disruption spells. By utilizing low-cost creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent, along with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Snuff Out, the deck aims to apply pressure early in the game. The deck also includes cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and enables the deck to cast its spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through disruption spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, along with powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. It also incorporates card advantage engines like Ponder and Brainstorm to fuel its control strategy. The inclusion of Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath provides additional value and resilience. The deck's mana base is built to support its multicolor spells, with fetchlands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors. Life from the Loam and Mystic Sanctuary provide additional utility and recursion options.

The deck focuses on quickly reducing your own life total to maximize the power of Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent while disrupting your opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal spells. It aims to apply pressure early in the game through creatures like Delver of Secrets and finish off the opponent with powerful threats like Death's Shadow. The deck's key strategy is to be aggressive and disruptive, forcing the opponent to react to your threats while protecting your own game plan.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents' mana bases with cards like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere to slow them down while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Legion Warboss. By utilizing fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of disruptive effects and powerful creatures. The deck's strategy revolves around locking opponents out of the game while maintaining a steady stream of pressure on the board to finish the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish a disruptive board presence with aggressive creatures such as Archon of Emeria and Solitude, backed up by powerful artifacts like Chalice of the Void and Cavern of Souls. The deck aims to control the game by limiting the opponent's ability to cast spells while applying pressure with efficient creatures. Additionally, the deck utilizes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Touch the Spirit Realm to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast-paced, proactive game plan.

The main concept of this Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt the opponent's mana base and game plan by playing powerful lock pieces like Blood Moon, Chalice of the Void, and Trinisphere. By utilizing fast mana acceleration with cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to quickly deploy aggressive threats such as Goblin Rabblemaster and Magus of the Moon to close out the game before the opponent can recover. The inclusion of Fury and other powerful red cards further enhances the deck's aggressive game plan, making it a formidable force in the Legacy format.

The main focus of this deck is to establish a strong lock on the game by utilizing artifacts to control the opponent's resources. The core strategy revolves around playing cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, and Karn, the Great Creator to restrict the opponent's options while also generating card advantage through cards like Karn, Scion of Urza and Serum Powder. The deck also incorporates powerful land cards like Urza's Saga and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain a proactive control of the board.

The key concept of this Jeskai Tempo deck is to establish early board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan by using efficient removal spells and counterspells. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Murktide Regent, while also maintaining card advantage through cards like Brainstorm and Mishra's Bauble. By utilizing tempo plays and denying the opponent their resources with cards like Wasteland and Daze, the deck seeks to control the pace of the game and win through a combination of creature beats and burn spells.

The main concept of this Aggro Dragon Stompy deck is to disrupt opponents by playing powerful lock pieces like Chalice of the Void, Blood Moon, and Trinisphere while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Goblin Rabblemaster and Fury. By leveraging mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with efficient threats and disruptive elements to control the game's tempo and close out the game quickly with high-powered creatures. The deck's strategy revolves around controlling the board and pressuring opponents with a mix of powerful creatures and punishing lockdown effects.
